ns2:section.sectionText: FA22 - ENGL 380, Paul Prior Topics in Writing Studies: Editing in theory and practice Editing is both a stand-alone profession and a significant component of many other kinds of work and community engagement. This course will review key frameworks for understanding the language, style, writing process, and authorship issues of editing as well as engage in practical exercises in following style manuals, shifting styles, understanding genre patterns, and arguing rhetorically and linguistically for specific editing decisions. The course will require reading, inquiry activities, and a combination of reflective writing, topic explorations, and practical editing activities.
